note: Family-owned campground in a wooded valley near the Minnesota River, about 2 miles from Le Sueur, with a playground and open lawns. Also rents sites by the month. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: $38 W/E, $43 FHU, $36 tent, $3 extra person over 4 (stored fees match); 36 sites (17 FHU, 18 W/E, 1 tent); 30/50 A (electric 50 set), water/sewer confirmed; showers, dump, store, wifi; laundry and pull-through cleared (operator silent); booking via request form (url set). Google 4.3/100, RV Life 4*/$$. Pin OK on the RV rows. Season not stated by the operator.
flags: Long-stay tests: (1) nightly sold ('or simply need a quiet place for an overnight stay'; nightly/weekend/weekly payment terms); (2) nightly price posted ($38-43); (3) no wording discourages nightly guests ('Come stay for a weekend, a month or for the whole season.'); (4) monthly sites at $640 under a Long Term/Monthly Agreement (deck/shed rules in the policy PDF) - the share is unpublished; leaf-on imagery shows about 15 RVs along the main rows with gaps, no sign that most sites are long-term; (5) presence: website, phone 507-665-2297, Google 4.3 from 100. Passes.
Price gate: base $38 (W/E 30/50 A), under US$50.
